name: qlrisk_price_interest_rate_floor
title: Price a InterestRateFloor
description:
Price one Interest Rate Floor - series of floorlets (qlrisk InterestRateFloor).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, strike_pct*, floating_index=SOFR, frequency=quarterly, volatility_pct, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, day_count, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000, "strike_pct": 3} gives NPV 45,309.64 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
